mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.5pp within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points within a month signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and supply-side strength, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure and potential tightening of monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is above 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.1 percentage points within a month, it signals a strong labor market, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.1pp within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month for two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% month-over-month for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, which typically supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1%.
